Definition: from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and φέλλος (in the sense of a stone as stubbing the foot); smoothness, i.e. (figuratively) simplicity:--singleness.
BiblicalUsage: Smoothness, simplicity — the believers breaking bread with gladness and singleness of heart, day by day in the temple and from house to house. The word is about a heart without folds in it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe singleness of heart is the mark of the early church I most want back: glad, simple, and together.
